questions.q: Where is the Annawadi slum located?
a: On swampy land beside Mumbai's airport
Beside a railway station in Delhi
On the outskirts of Kolkata
Near a beach outside Goa
questions.why: The summary describes a patch of swampy land hidden from view by a concrete airport wall.

questions.q: What usually happens when a slum child is hit by a car on the way to school?
a: The driver does not stop and police do not investigate
The driver pays for the child's hospital care
Police open a murder case the same day
Neighbors raise money for the family
questions.why: The summary says drivers rarely stop and the police often ignore such deaths.

questions.q: Why is it hard for Annawadians to get a voter card?
a: They are treated as criminals for living in the slum and must bribe officials
They are barred from elections because they lack birth records
They must own legal property before they can register
They are required to vote in a different state
questions.why: The summary explains that their illegal settlement status makes bribery the only route.

questions.q: What did the woman who ran the charity-funded school do to maximize profit?
a: Put her unqualified daughter in charge, teaching only on inspection days
Charged families tuition while refusing donations
Sold school supplies to families at a markup
Hired untrained teachers and kept their wages
questions.why: The summary describes the school as another example of corruption surrounding the residents.

questions.q: What happened after the Husains refused to pay their neighbor for claimed damage?
a: The neighbor set herself on fire, died, and the Husains were accused of murder
The neighbor sued them and took their savings in court
The police evicted the whole family from the slum
Community elders settled the dispute with a small payment
questions.why: The incident destroyed the family's savings and cost them the plot of land they had saved for.
